task:
Make the committed conformance suite test/supabase-members.test.ts pass. It is the SPEC and you CANNOT edit it (it is outside your write scope). Implement ONLY under src/supabase/. Build the transport-agnostic membership backend from docs/plans/2026-07-16-supabase-membership-provisioning.md (Sections 1-3, backend only):

1. src/supabase/constants.ts: add 'members' to the SupabaseCategory union.
2. src/supabase/classify.ts: classify GET /v1/organizations/{slug}/members -> { action: 'supabase:members:list', category: 'members', write: false, projectRef: null, resource: 'org:<slug>' }. This must be a SURGICAL special-case: the org root path and a POST to the members path must keep their existing 'organizations' mapping (member WRITE transport is internal/unstable and deferred to Task 0 - do not invent a members:invite classification).
3. src/supabase/member-schema.ts (new): export type MemberAssignment = { targetEmail: string; targetDomain: string; requestedRole: 'Owner'|'Administrator'|'Developer'|'Read-Only'; requestedProject: string | null } and export function parseMemberRequest(body: unknown): MemberAssignment[]. Input shape: { users: [ { email, role, project_refs? } ] }. Expand one user with N project_refs into N assignments; missing/empty project_refs -> one assignment with requestedProject null. Normalize role case-insensitively to the canonical name. targetDomain is the lowercased part after '@'. Throw on: unknown role, malformed email (no '@' / empty local or domain), exact duplicate assignment, empty/missing users. Use zod (already a dependency) at the boundary.
4. src/supabase/member-context.ts (new): export function buildMemberContexts(action: string, assignments: MemberAssignment[], resource: string, opts?: { productionRefs?: string[] }): RequestContext[] (import RequestContext from '../policy-types'). One context per assignment: { action, resource, fields } where fields carries scalar 'supabase.target_email', 'supabase.target_domain', 'supabase.requested_role', 'supabase.batch_size' (= String(assignments.length)), 'supabase.contains_production' (boolean: true iff requestedProject is in opts.productionRefs). Include 'supabase.requested_project' ONLY when requestedProject is non-null (omit the key for org-scoped assignments). Do NOT modify the policy engine - the existing evaluatePolicy already ANDs all contexts.

WORKFLOW: read the conformance test first to learn the exact expected shapes, then implement. Run `bun run typecheck` and `bunx vitest run test/supabase-members.test.ts` as you go.

HARD CONSTRAINTS: Edit ONLY files under src/supabase/. Do NOT weaken/skip/delete any test. Do NOT touch scripts/api-coverage or its fixtures. Do NOT add real fetch() calls to any Supabase endpoint. Run prettier (tabs, single quotes, semicolons, width 140) so `bun run lint` passes.
